author: 殷明骏
selected: APE version 1, full potential/elite and two-phase parameter control
selection_reason: Development mean rank improves on predecessor and DE; removing control substantially worsens performance; no superiority to DLS-DE or PEMS-DE inferred.
test: Two-sided paired Wilcoxon signed-rank, numerical ties abs<=1e-8 + 1e-10*max(abs(a),abs(b)), alpha .05
sensitivity: Report F01-F16 mean ranks without replacing complete suite; no confirmatory significance claim for this subset
review_criteria: Exact workload, saved-solution verification and original-file preservation
New algorithm has lower within-confirmation mean rank than both DE and TEAM
Primary corrected per-function wins and losses reported for both DE and TEAM
No unsupported superiority claim over strongest paper method
Complete numerical tables, ablations, best-run convergence curves and source code in final submission
prohibition: Do not tune algorithm or choose report exclusions using confirmation outcomes; any subsequent design revision needs a fresh master seed and declared development use of this sample.
